Methods
Whole genome sequencing
5ug of genomic DNA was sheared to a suitable size for HiFi using the Megaruptor 3.
Libraries were sequenced on the PacBio Sequel IIe.
Aphids were sent to Phase Genomics for Hi-C sequencing.

Genome assembly
Genome characteristics were assessed using Genomescope (v2). Initial contig
assemblies were generated using hifiasm (v0.16.1-r375) and was provided with
both HiFi and Hi-C data for improved haplotype resolution. Both genome copies
were individually scaffolded into linkage groups using YaHS (v1.2a.2). Blobtools
(v1.1) was used to identify symbiont contigs. Assembly completeness was
assessed using BUSCO (v5.2.2) and the arthropoda_odb10 database.
HiFi reads were also provided to MitoHiFi (v3.0.0) for mitochondrial genome
assembly. Symbionts were annotated using bakta (v1.9.3).

RNA Iso-seq sequencing
Iso-Seq libraries were sequenced on the PacBio Sequel IIe. Transcripts were
mapped with minimap2. Transcript assemblies were then provided to Augustus
(v3.5.0) for model training and gene prediction.
